worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.summary: Plants its feet and rolls one roar forward as a whole wall of sound: every foe inside the fan is hit by the same wall, almost regardless of distance, and shoved straight back. It ignores cover and the ground, and adds no status — it is simply the loudest, widest voice. Focus narrows it and sends it further and heavier.
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.use.0: Sweep a whole direction in front of you at once
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.use.1: Shove a charging pack straight back
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.use.3: Trade one long breath for the widest voice
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.description: The wall of sound sweeps out: each foe in the fan takes one blast of %1$s power, nearly the same near and far — the rim keeps about %2$s%% of it. The target's special defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
It opens %1$s degrees forward and pushes out %2$s blocks; it ignores cover and the ground, and covers exactly the fan it draws.
Those hit are shoved up to %1$s blocks away from the caster, lighter toward the rim; no status, only damage and displacement.
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.focused.on: Focus on: about ×0.6 fan, ×1.25 reach, ×1.15 shove and ×1.08 power, wind-up +2 and cooldown +4 ticks, folding the roar into one longer, heavier line.
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.focused.off: Focus off (spread): about ×1.3 fan, ×0.85 reach, ×0.8 shove and ×0.94 power, to cover a whole direction at once.
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.timing: Reaches %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s, the wall reaches %3$s blocks, and the shove rises to %4$s.
On: about ×0.6 fan, ×1.25 reach, ×1.15 shove and ×1.08 power, wind-up +2 and cooldown +4 ticks, folding the roar into one longer, heavier line for a tough target far away. Off (spread): about ×1.3 fan with slightly less power, to cover a whole direction at once.
The companion only considers Hyper Voice when a threat is this close; lower it to shout only at arm's reach, raise it to walk in further first.
At least this many visible foes must stand inside the fan before it fires; raise it to shout only into a crowd and save PP, set it to 1 to shout at a single target.
worldcombat.skill.hypervoice.description: One shout reaches at most %1$s foes in front; anyone beyond that is left out, and each target is hit only once by the wall.
